lines.en: Did I tell you about this one time that a bug crawled on me? It was a cockroach, specifically too.
lines.ja: 虫が私の体を這ってた話って もう話したかしら？ ちなみにゴキブリよ

lines.en: Did I say that before? I'm pretty sure I did.
lines.ja: 話したっけ？話したわよね

lines.en: I was sleeping in the comfort of my childhood home, one time.
lines.ja: 実家で横になっていた時の話よ

lines.en: And... Dude, I had my arms sorta extended out, y'know.
lines.ja: 腕を伸ばすような寝相だったのね

lines.en: Kinda using it as my headrest
lines.ja: 手に頭をのせて…腕枕ね

notes.meaning: 頭を乗せるもの、枕代わりのもの

lines.en: And while I was asleep, I was subconsciously waking up...
lines.ja: 寝てたんだけど ふと目が開いてね

lines.en: if that makes sense? I just felt like little, little tingles on my arm.
lines.ja: 寝ぼけまなこよ 腕が少しゾワゾワする感覚がしたの

notes.meaning: ピリピリ、ゾワゾワする感覚

lines.en: And I could feel something crawl. And at first I was like, "Oh, I wonder why I'm getting goosebumps at this time of night?"
lines.ja: 何かが這ってるような感じ こんな夜になんで鳥肌？と思ったわ

lines.en: Cause it's very late. And then, I just woke up...
lines.ja: 夜遅かったのよ それからハッキリ目が覚めると…

lines.en: Felt a little more tingles on that same arm. And then I
lines.ja: 腕のゾワゾワが強くなって もう恐怖で パニックで 腕ぶんぶん振って 震えながら電気つけて

lines.en: And that cockroach was just like Ah, ¡Vámonos!
lines.ja: 一方ゴキブリは… 「行くぜぇー！」

notes.meaning: スペイン語で「行こうぜ！」

lines.en: Oi, muy bien! I got a taste of the Shiori Novella Whoo!
lines.ja: 「最高ォー！」「シオリ・ノヴェラに触れちまったぜ！」「フゥー！」

lines.en: And then, And then, I was like "Oh good god!" And then, I tried to just stay up.
lines.ja: もうウワーッとなっちゃって それからはもう寝ずに

lines.en: Make sure that I get that cockroach before it comes back for round number two.
lines.ja: ヤツと大乱闘よ また来てラウンド2は勘弁だもの

lines.en: Or for revenge, for the ultimate smash.
lines.ja: 復讐に来られても困るしね

lines.en: I think I eventually did get the bug... But...
lines.ja: 最終的に何とかしたはずだけど でも…

lines.en: I think that memory is a little bit blurry at that point. But I'm pretty sure I got it, but not on the same day...
lines.ja: その時の記憶が曖昧でね 別の日に見つけたのは覚えてるわ

lines.en: I just assume it was the same bug.
lines.ja: あれはきっと同じヤツよ…
